description: Publish files and websites as shareable links on litehost.io and manage them through the Connect API. Use when the user asks to deploy, host, publish, share, upload, update, list, delete, archive or manage a site, file, project or custom domain on Litehost, send work to a client as one link, get a QR code for a link, or check their Litehost plan or quota.
